title: Knowledge and links
checkFirst: Paste a link. We check it before it is shared.
descriptionPlaceholder: What do people find there, and who is it useful for?
privacy: We only keep link, title and preview, never the file. Make sure everyone is allowed to open the link before you share it.

trustText.trusted: A well-known service. Nothing unusual came up.
trustText.checked: A site we do not know. Nothing unusual came up while checking. Still, do not enter passwords there.
trustText.caution: Something came up while checking. Only open the link if you trust the person.

notes.redirect: The link forwards to another site.
notes.short_link: This was a short link. We show and keep the real destination.
notes.look_alike: The address contains special characters and may look confusingly like a well-known site.
notes.odd_tld: The ending of this address is often used for fraud.
notes.archive: An archive (zip, rar …). Anything can be inside.
notes.private: The link is probably not public. Others may need access first.
notes.unreachable: The site did not answer just now.

blocks.not_a_link: That does not look like a link. It has to start with https://
blocks.credentials: The link contains a user name or password. We do not share that.
blocks.ip_address: Links with a number address instead of a name are not allowed.
blocks.internal: That is an internal address and cannot be reached on the internet.
blocks.port: Only normal web addresses are allowed (no special port).
blocks.executable: We do not share programs or installers.
blocks.unsafe: This address is on a warning list for fraud or malware.
blocks.unreachable: The site cannot be reached. Check the address.
blocks.short_link: We cannot tell where the short link leads. Please use the real link.
blocks.not_found: That page does not exist (any more). Check the address.

leaving: You are leaving HiveVoice. Only open links if you trust the sender.
empty: Nothing here yet. Share the first link.
askText: Post a wanted ad so others can send you fitting links.
groupIntro: Only the link is stored, not the file.
